summary.mouse_caveat: Mouse V/J gene names are OGRDB strain-inferred placeholder identifiers (e.g. IGHV0-24BS*00), not real IMGT family designations -- every mouse gene shares the same '0' family digit regardless of identity. No family-level rollup is computed for mouse; v_family is null for all mouse entries by design, not by omission.
summary.entry_level_partition_note: n_entries_with_assignment + n_entries_with_no_assignment == n_total_entries by construction. This summary was regenerated post hoc to fix a double-counting bug in the original run -- see PROJECT_HANDOFF for details.
